scope: Resend sender-domain verification, production send proof, webhook proof, and Vercel email/closed-beta flag enablement

resendDomainVerification.dashboardCopy: Domain verified: Your domain is ready to send emails.

dnsProof.authoritativeCommand: dig @dns1.registrar-servers.com +short MX send.contact.archestimator.com && dig @dns1.registrar-servers.com +short MX archestimator.com

productionSendProbe.command: vercel env run -e production --scope philipjonlewis-projects -- node <sanitized Resend send probe>

webhookProof.meaning: The production route reached signature verification; when RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET is absent this route returns HTTP 503 before verification.

vercelEnvProof.command: vercel env pull <tmp> --environment=production/preview --git-branch=main --yes --scope philipjonlewis-projects; grep only non-secret flag lines
vercelEnvProof.note: Boolean launch flags were converted to non-sensitive readable env vars so pull proof can show true; Resend API and webhook secret remain secret values and are not recorded.

remainingProofBeforeFullyGreenClosedBeta: Wait for the pushed main deployment to finish so the new explicit email flag guard is live with these env values.
Run a hosted shared-link or invite email workflow smoke if automatic email UX is part of the beta journey.
Run hosted denied/revoked/expired Google OAuth smoke and full hosted beta journey proof.
Resolve or explicitly accept the two residual Codex Security history-exposure findings.
